reference.question: Calculate the value of \(\tan 60^\circ\times\tan 30^\circ-(\cos 60^\circ)^2\). (Express the result as a fraction in simplest form.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Special-angle values

\(\tan 60^\circ\times\tan 30^\circ=\sqrt{3}\times\sqrt{3}/3=1\), and \((\cos 60^\circ)^2=1/4\), so the result is \(1-1/4=3/4\).
